description: This file defines the 'ConnectionMonitorRegistry' interface, which provides methods to initialize, reset, and retrieve counters for various metrics related to connections. It acts as a registry for monitors that track message metrics such as dispatched, filtered, published, dropped, acknowledged, consumed, mapped, and enforced messages in different directions (inbound/outbound) and for responses.

classes.name: ConnectionMonitorRegistry
classes.description: A generic interface for managing and retrieving connection monitors for various message metrics in a connectivity context.

methods.name: initForConnection
methods.description: Initializes all monitors for the provided connection.

methods.name: resetForConnection
methods.description: Removes all monitors associated with the provided connection from the registry.

methods.name: forOutboundDispatched
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for outbound dispatched messages for a given connection and target.

methods.name: forOutboundFiltered
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for outbound filtered messages for a given connection and target.

methods.name: forOutboundPublished
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for outbound published messages.

methods.name: forOutboundDropped
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for outbound dropped messages.

methods.name: forOutboundAcknowledged
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for outbound acknowledged messages.

methods.name: forInboundConsumed
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for inbound consumed messages.

methods.name: forInboundMapped
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for inbound mapped messages.

methods.name: forInboundDropped
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for inbound dropped messages.

methods.name: forInboundEnforced
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for inbound enforced messages.

methods.name: forInboundAcknowledged
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for inbound acknowledged messages.

methods.name: forResponseDispatched
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for dispatched response messages.

methods.name: forResponseDropped
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for dropped response messages.

methods.name: forResponseMapped
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for response mapped messages.

methods.name: forResponsePublished
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for published response messages.

methods.name: forResponseAcknowledged
methods.description: Returns a counter monitor for acknowledged response messages.
